causes.road: Probe used a 100ms delay plus canvas readiness after Redo, while planner write/refresh/source reload could still own saving. Cancel reset the old session while that read was pending; close could be refused by saving, leaving the old road editor and hidden new-plan button. Planner now owns aria-busy/inert until all phases finish; cancel cannot invalidate a pending canonical response. Probe waits actual cursor and planner, asserts old editor detached and new river identity/zero anchors, unchanged road, read-only preview and exactly one history action per explicit save.
causes.camera: River-only start seeded the initial localStorage frame again on restart, deleting the saved pose. Fixture view seeding now occurs only once. Independently, initial terrain publication overwrote a valid restored focus while ready=false. Presentation protects a valid complete restored pose before first overview and later detail; activation without one clears that protection. Navigation focus rebasing and terrain eye safety remain active.
causes.brushProbe: Full native run exposed immediate pointerdown before the public editing source was prepared. Probe now fits the selected road with visible controls, hovers then waits complete current revision/radius35 source, and waits canonical cursor+1 before checking brush effect; no private state reset.
